//: DOC-002: a Default for the owner's repositories.
text: Never write an em dash (U+2014) in a file, commit or PR; use a comma, colon, parentheses or a spaced hyphen.
why: The standards ban the em dash in every file and commit message.
enforced_by: the commitlint rule no-banned-dashes, for commit messages only
to_add: a U+2014 check on changed files, and a check after each write
